strategies.text:
1) Overview

Estimated Time to Win [277.5s - 295s]

This is a challenging solo which focuses on, maximizing energy absorbed by Necrozma Dawn Wings by absorbing charge attacks and well timed rejoins while using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor.


2) Main Strategy

Mega Gengar [1x]

  1. Leadoff: Mega Gengar's Shadow Ball can quickly make Azelf aggressive since it is able to provide 100 energy from a single cast. As a result, Azelf may begin casting charge moves sooner than usual. Switch to NDW when Azelf casts a heavy charge move (E.g: Future Sight/Fire Blast)
  2. Executor: Mega Gengar can optionally be swapped in to deal a fast knock out blow with shadow ball. This would outspeed the slower Moongeist Beam.

Necrozma Dawn Wings [3-5x]

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once an active NDW is too low to continue, swap to the next one.
  4. Dodging on Necrozma Dawn Wings is NOT ENCOURAGED. Over investment into survivability will put you behind pace.
  5. Use Psycho Cut if executing TPC strategy, otherwise the lesser DPS Shadow Claw is still viable & more friendly.


3) Advanced DPS Tips:

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]: DPS Increase: ~4.5%

  1. While not required, it is extremely helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut.
  2. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred, Shadow Claw may be the better option.

Substitute [Sub]:

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps prevent this for increased consistency.

Double Catch Tank (Fire Blast): DPS Increase: ~2.0%

  1. Against Fire Blast, some players have opted to Double catch tanking which involves swapping a NDW to intercept fire blast, twice. On the second swap, NDW will fire moongeist beam. Because Fire Blast grants ~40 energy, catching 2 of these followed by a few fast moves results in a quick Moongeist Beam. This strategy can be used to increase consistency & DPS. Beware, this does not work in Clear/Sunny weather.


4) Video Credits:

  1. https://www.youtube.com/@SpiritedBloom
  2. https://www.youtube.com/@nikkootin6954

1) Overview

Estimated Time to Win [264s - 288s]

This is a moderate level solo which focuses on, maximizing energy absorbed by Necrozma Dawn Wings and executing well timed rejoins. Mega Gengar can optionally be used as a leadoff, support DPSer and Executor.

Other viable support DPSers include Shadow Darkrai & Shadow Chandelure. Use with caution as their DPS are well behind an optimized NDW.


2) Main Strategy

Necrozma Dawn Wings [3-5x]

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once the active NDW is too low to cast another Moongeist Beam, swap to the next one. Do not let it faint.
  4. Dodging on Necrozma Dawn Wings is NOT ENCOURAGED. Over investment into survivability will put you behind pace.

Mega Gengar [1x]

  1. Can optionally contribute good DPS as well.
  2. Dodge Future Sights.


3) Advanced DPS Tips

Leadoff/Accelerator: DPS Increase: Minimal

  1. Mega Gengar can optionally be used here to accelerate the boss's aggression early by landing the cheaper cost shadow ball. This allows Azelf to cast charge moves sooner.

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]: DPS Increase: ~5%

  1. While not required, it is helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut.
  2. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred

Substitute [Sub]: Consistency Increase

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue. Time Save: Varies
